definitions: Kubelet is an agent that runs on each node in a Kubernetes cluster. It registers the node with the apiserver and ensures that containers are running in a pod.

Kube-proxy is a network proxy that runs on each node in a Kubernetes cluster. It maintains network rules on nodes and enables network communication to your Pods from network sessions inside or outside of the cluster.
examples: The kubelet and kube-proxy are essential components for node operation.
Without a functioning kubelet and kube-proxy, pods cannot be managed or accessed.
Troubleshooting often involves checking the status of the kubelet and kube-proxy.
